# Superstacks 6.4.0

Reviews of scanners and guards must be independent, and "ready" means every comment was read.

This tag is for the owner to create later. This pull request does not push `v6.4.0`.

## Changes

- A change that adds or alters a finder or refuser (scanner, inventory, guard, lint rule, drift test, validator) needs a review with an independent count or trace and a set of probes, each marked found or missed. A missed form in real code today is at least high severity; one that does not exist today is recorded as a stated limit (`interrogate`, `code-review`)
- `verification-before-completion` gains a "before you say ready" step: read every comment and review since your last one, and name the method behind none, all, safe and always
- `pr` gains a `## Review` section; a body with `Class: finder` must name the independent check and the probes, enforced by `check_pr_body.py`
